# James O'Sullivan

James O'Sullivan is a software and mechatronics engineering student from Cork, Ireland. He was selected for Patch 2026, competed in VEX Robotics with a peak team ranking of #1 in Europe, and received an Honourable Mention in the 2026 Irish Mathematical Olympiad (IrMO). He is also the co-founder and engineer of Heron Labs.

## Notable work

- Heron Labs / Agami: semi-autonomous vessel for river monitoring, collecting GPS-tagged nitrate, conductivity, turbidity and temperature measurements. James led electronics, embedded sensing, ESP32 firmware, LTE/GNSS telemetry, navigation, web monitoring and field testing.
- VEX Robotics: reached a peak ranking of #1 in Europe in the 2026 season and attended the VEX World Championship in St. Louis, Missouri.

## Achievements and recognition

- Patch 2026: selected for Patch's two-month summer accelerator in Dublin, a cohort of 36 young technologists, scientists and entrepreneurs aged 16–23. James developed Heron Labs during the programme.
- Irish Mathematical Olympiad (IrMO) 2026: received an Honourable Mention.
- UCC Math Tutoring Programme: certified mathematics tutor, tutoring local Junior Certificate students.
- Hack Club Vienna: earned a fully funded place at an international Hack Club hackathon.
- VEX Robotics World Championship: qualified and travelled to St. Louis with the team after fundraising through sponsorship and a 96FM appearance.
- Outside engineering: placed first in the Munster Schools Badminton Championship, placed second in tennis, completed the Cork Marathon 10K, and holds lifeguard and first-aid certifications.

## Other work

Robotics education, assistive technology, computer vision, embedded systems, full-stack software, and mathematical tutoring.
